subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: The system shall treat a feature draft as ready only when every blocking finding from the PRD review and the tech-spec review of the exact version being locked carries a disposition — applied, or declined with the operator's ruling.
rationale: The final review of the version being locked has no unresolved blocking finding (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-3)
fit_criterion: A draft revised after its last review is refused until both reviews re-run on the new version; a draft with one undispositioned blocking finding is refused; dispositioned findings pass.
